newsitem.title: RUSSIA: St Petersburg Eurobond seen placed on Monday.
newsitem.headline: St Petersburg Eurobond seen placed on Monday.

text.p: The City of St Petersburg, which is currently doing a road-show for its debut Eurobond, will announce the terms of placement next Monday, a senior government official said on Wednesday.
"The results will be announced on Monday," Dmitry Sergeyev, St Petersburg deputy mayor, told Reuters. "Today and tomorrow we will be doing last checks."
St Petersburg plans to raise up to $300 million by placing a Eurobond with a two to five-year maturity.
Last week the City of Moscow became the pioneer Russian city to place a Eurobond with a successfull $500 million three-year issue at a spread of 315 basis points over U.S. Treasuries.
